set.body:
Objective

Extend the coherent/configuration decomposition to rectangular forms without pretending configuration has a one-vector Wq collapse.

Primary ownership

R/task.R, R/kernel.R, R/compiler.R, result component access, memory planning, and numerical tests.

Deliverables

For each ordered edge and measurement, retain total evidence, left first moments, right first moments, and frame mass. Compute coherent forms as outer(u_left,u_right)/mass and configuration as total minus coherent. Direct configuration queries use total Wq minus the local bilinear first-moment correction.

Acceptance

Total-minus-coherent equals explicit weighted feature centering for rectangular and self forms; singleton frames have zero configuration; direct and materialized component queries agree; current coherent/configuration outputs remain unchanged within the numerical contract; memory receipts include both side states and all live temporaries.

Non-goals

No cosine, Pearson, Fisher, rank, or pair-space regression constructors.
set.title: Generalize coherent and configuration sufficient statistics
